title: Lesson 43: Case Study: Coding Agents (Hermes, Claude Code, and Copilot Under the Hood)
description: The coding agent as the cleanest example of the agent loop: a self-running verifier, a spectrum from autocomplete to cloud agents, and a tool surface built from models that reason and tools that act.

questions.question: Per the lesson "Case Study: Coding Agents (Hermes, Claude Code, and Copilot Under the Hood)", what does a coding agent have that the browser agent from the previous case study did not?
options: A verifier that runs itself, because a test, build, or linter returns a pass or fail the agent can read in the same conversation
A larger model with a longer context window
A human reviewer standing by for every step
questions.explanation: The lesson says the one idea to carry out is that a coding agent gets a verifier that runs itself, which changes both the reliability math and what done means, and contrasts it with the browser agent that needed external verification.

questions.question: The lesson places coding assistants on a spectrum. Which description matches the cloud agent rung?
options: Ghost text after the cursor that you accept with one key press
An agent that works in a background ephemeral environment, runs tests and linters there, and hands back a pull request to review
An agent that edits your local working tree only after you approve each file
A chat window that explains code without touching any files
questions.explanation: The lesson describes Copilot's cloud agent as working in the background in its own ephemeral development environment, executing tests and linters and opening a pull request, with the blast radius contained to a reviewable diff.

questions.question: What does the lesson say about the harness?
options: The harness is the model itself, and tools are optional extras
The harness is a second model that reviews the first model's edits
The model alone can only emit text; the harness supplies the tools, context management, and execution environment that make it a coding agent
The harness is a fixed program whose behavior cannot be extended
questions.explanation: The lesson quotes the docs describing the harness as the layer providing tools, context management, and execution environment, and adds that tools are what make the model agentic and the tool surface is where capability is extended.
